summary:
MongoDB EPS 1.32 美元超預期11.5%、營收年增25.3%，Atlas 雲端資料庫與 AI 應用需求強勁。
• EPS 1.32 美元，超預期 11.54%，獲利優於估計
• 營收 6.876 億美元，年增 25.25%，Atlas 帶動成長
• AI 原生應用推升現代資料庫採用
• 雲端消費型營收與客戶數穩步擴張
ai_view:
訊號正向：營收與獲利雙超預期且維持逾25%成長，顯示 Atlas 雲端資料庫受 AI 應用浪潮帶動，現代資料庫採用結構性向上。短期財報利多支撐股價。中期追蹤 Atlas 營收占比與消費動能、淨新增客戶與大型客戶數、AI 工作負載貢獻，以及營業利潤率改善能否與成長同步。估值高度依賴成長持續，須留意消費型營收的景氣敏感度。

需留意：雲端消費型營收對景氣與用量敏感；與雲端原生資料庫服務競爭加劇；無本益比參考，獲利仍在成長期，估值依賴成長

summary_en:
MongoDB beat EPS at $1.32 by 11.5% with 25.3% revenue growth, on strong Atlas and AI application demand.
• EPS of $1.32 beat by 11.54%, ahead of estimates
• Revenue of $687.6M grew 25.25%, led by Atlas
• AI-native applications boost modern database adoption
• Steady growth in cloud consumption revenue and customers

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: revenue and earnings both beat with 25%+ growth, showing Atlas riding the AI application wave with structurally rising modern-database adoption. Near term the beat supports the stock. Mid term, track Atlas revenue mix and consumption momentum, net-new and large customers, AI workload contribution, and whether operating margin improves alongside growth. The valuation depends heavily on sustained growth, so watch the macro sensitivity of consumption revenue.

Watch：Cloud consumption revenue is sensitive to macro and usage; Intensifying competition with cloud-native database services; No P/E; profitability still maturing, valuation depends on growth
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 11.54%、營收年增 25.25%，雙雙強勁。
